name: devmate
description: Real hands on your own computer for ChatGPT, Claude and any MCP client: project files, shell, Git, editor diagnostics and local coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Work on your local projects from chat
interface.longDescription: Read, search and edit project files, run commands and tests, use Git, see editor errors, and hand tasks to coding agents installed on your computer. Includes a workbench for agents, tasks and approvals.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my project and what its tests say.
